999008199.text:
まったく……急に来たと思ったら、
ゼロと話がしたいなんて驚いたよ！

localizations.en: Honestly... you show up out of nowhere and the first thing you want is to talk to Zero? You had me surprised!

999008199.text:
てへっ……許してくれてホント助かるわ、クレオ。
すっごくありがと！

localizations.en: Hehe... I'm really glad you let me. Thanks a million, Creo!

999008199.text: 私は寛大なことに定評があるからね！

localizations.en: What can I say—I'm known for my generosity!

999008199.text: ヘルトの様子はどう？

まだ相変わらず、かな。声をかけても、一切反応を
示さなくて、むしろ悪化している気すらするよ

localizations.en: Same as before, I'd say. No response to anything we try. If anything, it seems like he's getting worse.

999008199.text: そっか……
ゼロ。今日はあんたと話をしに来たわ

localizations.en: Zero. I came to talk with you today.

999008199.text:
ん？　我か？
なんじゃ、何用じゃ

localizations.en: Hm? With me? What dost thou want?

999008199.text:
ヘルトのことよ。あんたになら、ヘルトがどうして
今の状態になってるか分かるかなって

localizations.en: It's about Held. I thought maybe you'd know why he's in this state.

999008199.text: それをちょっと深いところで、考えたくってさ

localizations.en: I want to really think it through—get to the root of it.

999008199.text: そんなの、決まっとろう！　深くいく必要もない

localizations.en: Obviously I do! There is nothing to think about!

999008199.text: え、分かるの！？

兄者は、うぬらに負けたのが悔しいんじゃ！
そうに決まっとる！

localizations.en: Brother is frustrated that he lost to thee lot! It is as simple as that!

999008199.text:
……えぇ？　ほ、本当に、
そんな子どもっぽい理由？

localizations.en: ...Huh? Is that... really it? That seems a bit...

999008199.text:
そうじゃ、絶対そうじゃ。
兄者は今まで負けなし。ゆえに一等悔しいのじゃ

localizations.en: It is! It must be! He has never lost before. That is why it stings so greatly!

999008199.text:
うーん、初めての敗北に悔しくなるのは分かるけど、
それであそこまで落ち込むかしら……

localizations.en: I get that a first defeat would sting, but enough to leave him like this...?

999008199.text: あんたたちはパルメ族の命令で動いていたのよね？

localizations.en: You and Held were acting on orders from the Palme, weren't you?

999008199.text:
我も兄者も、パルメ族の命令には従わぬ！
我らは我らの好きなように生きるんじゃ

localizations.en: Neither of us follow the Palme's orders! We live as we please!

999008199.text:
まぁ、我と兄者を強く創ったことには
感謝してやらんでもないがな

localizations.en: ...Though I will grant that they deserve some thanks for making us so strong.

999008199.text:
うぬは可哀そうじゃのお。調合機能なぞという、
余計なものに力を割り振られてしまって

localizations.en: Thou art the pitiable one. To have thy power squandered on a synthesis function, of all things.

999008199.text:
余計なものじゃないわよ！
……って、そっか。あんたらは錬金術を使えないのね

localizations.en: It is not squandered! ...But wait—so you two can't use alchemy at all?

999008199.text:
我らはパルメ族を守るため、脅威に対抗するために
ただ強くあれと創られたからの。最強であれ、と

localizations.en: We were made to be strong—to guard the Palme and face any threat. Nothing more. To be the mightiest of all.

999008199.text: 最強……

そうだよね。世界の管理者を名乗っていても、
強くなければ管理はできないし、民も従わない

localizations.en: Right. Even if you call yourself a guardian of the world, you can't actually protect anything without strength. People won't follow you otherwise.

999008199.text:
もしかしたら、ヘルトにも重圧があったのかも。
最初の九偉人として誰よりも強くなければ、みたいなね

localizations.en: Maybe Held felt the pressure of that too. Being first of the Nine—having to be stronger than anyone else.

999008199.text: 重圧？

うん。自分に向けられる期待ってさ、嬉しい反面
重いんだ。立場があると、余計に

localizations.en: Yeah. The expectations people put on you—it's flattering, sure. But it weighs on you. Especially when you're in a position like his.

999008199.text: 兄者は強いのだから、そんな重圧を感じるはずない！

localizations.en: Brother is strong! He would never be weighed down by such things!

999008199.text: 兄には、妹には分からない重責があるのかもよ？

localizations.en: An older sibling can carry burdens a younger one might never see.

999008199.text:
（ヘルトにも、そう思うことがあったのかしら……
　最強でなければという、重圧……）

localizations.en: (Did Held ever feel that way...? That he had to be the strongest, no matter what?)

999008199.text:
（確かにゼロの言う通り、しっくりはこない。
　でもクレオの言いたいことも分かる）

localizations.en: (Zero's answer doesn't quite sit right—but I understand what Creo's getting at too.)

999008199.text:
……ありがとう、二人とも。
ヘルトのこと、少し分かった気がする

localizations.en: ...Thank you, both of you. I think I understand him a little better now.

999008199.text:
他の兄弟たちからも、話を聞いてみる。
ヘルトのこと、もっと知って理解したいし

localizations.en: I'll go talk to the others too. The more I know about Held, the better I can understand him.

999008199.text: なぜ、兄者のことを理解したいのじゃ

localizations.en: Why dost thou wish to understand brother so?

999008199.text:
なぜって……あんなことあったけど、兄弟だし、
今のヘルトが心配だから

localizations.en: Why? Because...after everything, he's still family. And I'm worried about him.

999008199.text:
……記憶をなくした時、私は生きる目的も理由も
分からなくなって、空っぽだった。けど――

localizations.en: ...When I lost my memory, I lost all sense of why I was alive. I was completely empty. But—

999008199.text:
そんな私を、ハイディたち家族が支えてくれた。
おかげで、今の元気いっぱいな私がいるわ

localizations.en: Heidi and the others were there for me. Their support is the reason I'm back to being my full self today.

999008199.text:
だから私も、家族として今のヘルトに
何かできないかなって思うのよ

localizations.en: So I want to do the same for Held. Be there for him, as family.

999008199.text:
……そうか。
兄者の話であれば、また聞きに来るがよい

localizations.en: ...Is that so. Then come again, if thou wouldst speak of brother.

999008199.text:
ありがとう、ゼロ。もっとヘルトのことを知って、
また会いに来るわ

localizations.en: Thank you, Zero. I'll learn more about Held, and come back to see you.

999008199.text: クレオ！　それまで、この二人のことよろしく！

localizations.en: Creo! Look after these two until then!

999008199.text:
分かった！
二人の身柄は国で責任をもって預かってるね

localizations.en: You got it! The kingdom will take good care of them.

999008199.text: さ、次は誰に話を聞きに行こうかしら

localizations.en: Now then—who should I talk to next?
